reading: Joined on role, a reading: Zid's Terms name the company that owns Zid and is called "we" or "Zid" in them, شركة القدرة التقنية لتقنية المعلومات والاتصالات ذ.م.م, commercial registration 1010365366 (ZD-S-0730), and put the Terms under the laws of Saudi Arabia (ZD-S-0727), as Shopify's Terms name the Shopify Contracting Party and Ontario law (SH-S-0001, SH-S-0010) and Salla's agreements name the company that owns Salla (SA-S-0017). Zid's own heading is النظام الحاكم وآلية حسم النزاعات. All its statements are cited in CM-ACC-002 only. Gaps: whether Zid has separate entities for the Gulf countries, an API field naming the entity, and a reason for Saudi law (ZD-C-030/responsible, boundary and reason: searched, not found).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid Egypt (زد مصر) operates under its own commercial registration 201574 and tax number, at an address in Cairo (ZD-S-0737, ZD-S-0738, ZD-S-0739), for compliance with Egyptian requirements (ZD-S-0740): a company of Zid for one market, as Shopify names a Contracting Party per region (SH-S-0005, SH-S-0007). Strained on two counts: no statement says Zid Egypt is the party merchants in Egypt contract with (ZD-C-031/responsible: searched, not found; Q1 notes zid.eg serves the same Terms naming the Saudi entity), so the fit to "contracting party" is a reading; and its where statements (ZD-S-0735, ZD-S-0736), Zid's expansion to Egypt, are cited in CM-ACC-008, another tree.

Joined by terms, a reading: Zid's "ZID is available in" (زد متاحة في) and its statement that Zid serves merchants located in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf only, of every nationality (ZD-S-0742), are Salla's Available in (مدعوم في) with its primary markets Saudi Arabia then the GCC (SA-S-0003): the countries where the platform offers its service. Zid also lists pages for Egypt, the UAE, Kuwait, Oman and Syria under Other countries (ZD-S-0741), and Zid Payments is stated for Saudi Arabia and Kuwait (ZD-S-0743, scope Zid Payments). All its statements are cited in CM-ACC-008 only.

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's activity type (نوع النشاط: فرد، مؤسسة، شركة، جمعية خيرية), chosen under the store's business details in Settings > Store > Store data (ZD-S-0753, ZD-S-0751), and read with the Commercial Registration by the Business endpoint (ZD-S-0757), is what Shopify defines as the business entity, "the registered business or individual the store operates as" (SH-S-0248), and Salla's choice of entity type, فرد, in its verification step (SA-S-0133). The names differ (activity, entity), the role is the same. All its statements are cited in CM-ACC-004 only. The verification by the Saudi Business Center (ZD-S-0752) is of the business's data, not of the people behind it, so it is cited here and left out of CM-TRU-002 (reading; notes).

Joined by terms, a reading: Zid's Account (Merchant APIs > Account > Me, the user account's identity, ZD-S-0086) and its account settings, email and password, in Settings > Account settings (اعدادات الحساب, ZD-S-0900), are Shopify's Account (SH-S-0019) and Salla's profile, Edit profile (SA-S-1762). Strained: the concern also holds the store's own record, Merchant APIs > Account > Store and third_store_details_read, "the store's core details" (ZD-S-0002, ZD-S-0087, ZD-I-0089, ZD-I-0091), and the permission manage.store.settings (ZD-I-0519), which are cited in CM-ACC-006, another tree. Batch 2 also cites ZD-S-0902 in CM-TRU-001 as shows (the coordinator).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's team (فريق العمل), reached from the Settings icon (ZD-S-0938), whose plan line Add Team Members adds team members such as a manager, an accountant or order fulfillment staff and sets each one's permissions (ZD-S-0939), is Shopify's Users (SH-S-1482) and Salla's Staff members (SA-S-1849): the people other than the owner working in the store's admin. Zid's word is team, not staff. Its permissions statements (ZD-S-0940, ZD-S-0942) are cited in the child CM-STF-002 and its team groups (ZD-I-0151) in the child CM-STF-003, one tree.

Joined by terms: Zid's subscriptions (الاشتراكات, Subscription Fees) and its plans Starter, Rise, Growth and Pro with their prices (ZD-S-0672), managed under إدارة الأشتراك (ZD-S-0671), are Shopify's Plan (SH-S-1487, whose terms include Subscription Fees) and Salla's Store plan (SA-S-1679). Strained: the concern is the subscription with its billing, and its fee clauses, the fees' currency, price changes and the invoice (ZD-S-0673, ZD-S-0674, ZD-S-0676), are cited in CM-PLN-004 and its VAT clause (ZD-S-0675) in CM-PLN-007, another tree.

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's Terms section on purchases from Zid (المدفوعات والمشتريات) says how the merchant pays Zid for what it buys: through a third-party payment processor whose terms the merchant accepts, which Zid may switch (ZD-S-0680, ZD-S-0679), with the purchase's information passed to third parties (ZD-S-0681). It is the means the platform charges for its fees, as Shopify's billing payment methods (SH-S-7171) and Salla's store balance paying the plan (SA-S-0089). All its statements are cited in CM-PLN-005 only. Gap: the processor is not named (ZD-C-021/responsible: searched, not found).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's Value Added Services (خدمة المميزات الإضافية VAS) are services Zid charges the merchant for, at prices it may revise after notice (ZD-S-0720), refunded on a ticket request (ZD-S-0718), one of the platform's charges to the merchant that Shopify's Billing (SH-S-6312) and Salla's Balance & billing (SA-S-1682) hold. Strained: VAS is a set of paid services, not billing as such, and Zid gives it no place of its own, only a section of its Terms (ZD-I-0421), so it is not made a capability (the dry run's convention); and its requirement of an activated store (ZD-S-0719) is cited in CM-ONB-002, another tree. The reviewer may split it if another platform gives paid add-ons a place.

Joined by terms: Zid's Live Chat Support (الدعم الفني عبر المحادثات, ZD-S-1004), its Ticketing & Chat System (ZD-S-1003), tickets from the dashboard (ZD-S-1077), 24/7 priority support on Professional (ZD-S-0378) and a dedicated merchant relation manager on Professional (ZD-I-0395) are Shopify's 24/7 support from Live chat to Priority support by plan (SH-S-7015) and Salla's account manager (SA-S-5006). All its statements are cited in CM-ONB-003 only. Strained: batch 2 cites a merchant's objection by ticket (ZD-S-1077) in CM-TRU-012, another tree (the coordinator).

Moved from domain C after batch 1 (the coordinator). The shared term is wallet: Zid's merchant wallet, to add balance, buy Zid's products or services and transfer out (ZD-S-0648), and Salla's navigation link Wallet (SA-S-1876). Batch 1 cites all its statements in CM-PLN-006 and CM-PLN-005, one tree under CM-PLN-004, so the fit is clean.

Joined on terms: Zid's security settings (اعدادات الامان, Security Settings) hold two-step verification, "تفعيل التحقق بخطوتين" (ZD-S-0943), "two-factor authentication (2FA) and other advanced security options" on every plan (ZD-S-0944), as Salla's نظام التحقق بخطوتين (SA-S-5115) and Shopify's Security settings page with two-step authentication (SH-S-1484). Its security levels, such as signing out an inactive member after half an hour (ZD-S-0945), are sign-in security of the same page. All its statements are cited in CM-TRU-001 only. Gap: no clause places responsibility for it by name (ZD-C-095/responsible: stated only in general terms).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid requires the store owner to pass verification through Nafath (نفاذ) to activate Zid Pay (ZD-S-0775), "Verify your identity with Nafath using the store owner's ID" (ZD-S-0778): the identity of the person behind the store, as Salla checks the store owner through Absher in store verification (SA-S-0132) and Shopify requires identity verification for Shopify Capital or Credit (SH-S-0264). Zid's step sits in Zid Pay's activation, so its statements carry Zid Pay's context; all are cited in CM-TRU-002 only. Gap: no reason for requiring Nafath is stated (ZD-C-038/reason: searched, not found).

Joined on terms: Zid's E-commerce store regulations (ضوابط المتجر الإلكتروني) require every store and merchant to keep the laws regulating online trade, among them أنظمة وزارة التجارة والاستثمار and نظام التجارة الإلكترونية (ZD-S-0760), to disclose the licence of goods or services that need one (ZD-S-0761) and to disclose its name, address, commercial registration and contacts in the store (ZD-S-0759): the merchant's compliance as the seller, as Salla's أنظمة وزارة التجارة (SA-S-0118) and Shopify's regulatory compliance and legal disclosures (SH-S-0012). All its statements are cited in CM-TRU-010 only.

Joined on terms: Zid's Privacy Policy (سياسة الخصوصية) says Zid acts as a "data processor" and "service provider" (ZD-S-0787), under the direction of the merchant, whose own privacy policy applies (ZD-S-0788), as Shopify's DPA makes the merchant Data Controller and Shopify Data Processor (SH-S-0186) and Salla publishes its privacy policy (SA-S-2209). Its statements on service providers (ZD-S-0791), retention (ZD-S-0786) and disclosure to public entities (ZD-S-0792) are cited in CM-TRU-015, CM-TRU-016 and CM-TRU-017, children of CM-TRU-013, the same tree, so the fit is clean.

Joined on terms: Zid's section on cross-border data transfer (نقل البيانات عبر الحدود) says Zid may transfer personal data to parties in other countries under the relevant laws (ZD-S-0794, ZD-S-0795), only with appropriate safeguards (ZD-S-0796), as Shopify's international transfers (SH-S-0639) and Automattic's data accessed outside the EEA or UK (WC-S-0659). Gap that bears on it: where Zid stores data is not stated (ZD-C-041/where: searched, not found; observation needed), so only the transfer half of the capability is held.

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's section on AI data processing (معالجة البيانات بالذكاء الاصطناعي) names Google Cloud Vertex AI as a data processor for Zid Agent (ZD-S-0717), processing store data solely on Zid's behalf (ZD-S-0799), with Zid determining the purposes and means (ZD-S-0798): a third party the platform engages to process data, as Shopify's third-party subprocessors (SH-S-0184), Google Cloud among them (SH-S-0195). Strained: it names the processor of one feature, not a list of subprocessors or notice of their changes; its consent clause (ZD-S-0797) is about the feature; and ZD-S-0717 is held under ZD-C-025 too, Zid Agent, domain F (CM-AIA-002), which this part does not cite. All its statements are cited in CM-TRU-015 only. Gap: the region where Vertex AI processes the data is not stated (ZD-C-042/where: searched, not found).

Moved from domain D after A-zid (the coordinator). A join on role, a reading: in Zid Assurance, Zid handles any complaints or inquiries against stores (ZD-S-0998), as Salla is link and mediator between merchant and customer (SA-S-5087). Batch 2 cites its statements in this cell. Strained: its WhatsApp order updates (ZD-S-0999) are cited in D's CM-NTF-001.
